performance.verdict: Meta CPL holding but 9 SOW milestones overdue — execution risk dwarfs ad performance.

findings.text: 5 milestones due 2026-07-31 undelivered: stack test, Como→GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta account/CAPI, and landing pages — 55 days overdue.
4 further milestones due Aug 31–Sep 1 also undelivered: reactivation lanes, search campaigns, LSA verification, nurture sequences — phase 1 attribution broken.
CPL rose 16.45% week-over-week as spend surged 229.1%; 3-day leads (Sep 21–23: 20+14+7=41) vs prior 3 (Sep 18–20: 7+4+11=22) still healthy but cost per lead creeping up.
MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP consumed $331.10 of $496.67 (67%) over 28 days with zero GA4 conversion events and zero GHL pipeline data — results unverifiable downstream.
GBP actions fell 54.55% week-over-week (last 4 days show 2, 2, 0, 0) while paid spend tripled — organic profile not lifting with paid activity.

suggestions.text: Escalate 9 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer and Sohib; block any further Meta budget increases until stack test clears.
suggestions.monday_update: Nine SOW milestones are overdue by up to 55 days, including the end-to-end stack test, Como→GHL migration, landing pages, and Meta CAPI — all required before attribution is trustworthy. No lead-to-appointment path is confirmed, meaning the 95 leads at $5.23 CPL cannot be validated as booked appointments. Escalate to Nacer and Sohib immediately; gate any budget increases above the current $44.61/day run rate on stack test completion. Success check: stack test confirmed complete by 2026-10-01.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline to confirm 95 Meta leads are entering as opportunities; surface intake leak if opps are flat.
suggestions.monday_update: The 28-day window shows 95 Meta leads and $496.67 spend, but GHL pipeline data returned null — there is no confirmed link between ad leads and booked appointments, which is Phase 1's primary KPI. Pull the GHL opportunity count for the matching date range and compare against the 95 leads reported by Meta. If opportunities are materially lower, the issue is intake routing, not ad performance. Report findings by 2026-09-27.

suggestions.text: Watch CPL on MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP for 3 more days; do not scale past $44.61/day until GHL audit (S2) clears.
suggestions.monday_update: CPL rose 16.45% week-over-week even as 3-day lead volume (41 leads, Sep 21–23) is strong; the direction is acceptable but the cost trend needs 3 more days of data before a scale decision is defensible. More importantly, the $331.10 MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP campaign has no downstream validation (GHL null, GA4 conversions zero). Hold the daily budget at current levels (~$44.61/day) until the GHL audit in S2 is complete. Re-check 2026-09-27.
